stories.title: Verstappen takes first Red Bull pole of 2026 after beating Hamilton in Bahrain GP qualifying
stories.summary: Max Verstappen claimed his first pole of the season for Sunday's Bahrain Grand Prix in Malaysia, topping every qualifying segment and beating Lewis Hamilton by 0.298s at Sepang. Championship leader Kimi Antonelli qualified fourth after a Q2 track-limits mistake, with George Russell down in seventh.

stories.title: Red Bull's Verstappen grabs pole position for Bahrain GP in Malaysia
stories.summary: Verstappen takes Bahrain GP pole for the first time this season, with Hamilton on the front row alongside him at Sepang. Red Bull's Isack Hadjar was third fastest but slips to eighth on the grid due to a five-place engine penalty.

stories.title: Browns top AFC North after Week 4 win over Steelers (Saturday roundup)
stories.summary: Cleveland sits in first place in the AFC North after Thursday's win over Pittsburgh, with Deshaun Watson becoming the second QB in team history to lead fourth-quarter game-winning drives in three straight games. Meanwhile, defensive tackle Mason Graham's knee injury is not as bad as feared, though he remains out for a while.

stories.title: How to watch No. 5 Ohio State at Iowa: kickoff time, TV channel
stories.summary: Ohio State's first trip to Iowa City in nine years kicks off at 3:30 p.m. ET Saturday on WBNS-10TV/CBS, with College GameDay on site at Kinnick Stadium. The undefeated Hawkeyes own the nation's top scoring defense, setting up a top-15 Big Ten showdown.

stories.title: Ohio State right tackle Phillip Daniels out for Saturday's game at Iowa
stories.summary: Fifth-ranked Ohio State will be without starting right tackle Phillip Daniels for its road test at No. 14 Iowa, with Austin Siereveld sliding into the spot. Nickel corner Jay Timmons is questionable as the Buckeyes' offensive line faces a stiff challenge in Iowa City.

stories.title: Federal disaster aid approved for 7 Ohio counties, incl. Franklin and Licking, after August storms
stories.summary: President Trump approved a major disaster declaration for seven Ohio counties — including Franklin and Licking near central Ohio — after August storms brought flooding and tornadoes that killed two and injured several. Residents of the approved counties can now apply for FEMA grants and SBA low-interest loans.

stories.title: Olentangy Orange girls' soccer coaching staff placed on paid leave amid hazing probe
stories.summary: The entire coaching staff of Olentangy Orange High School's girls' soccer team has been placed on paid administrative leave amid an investigation into alleged hazing reported over the summer. The Delaware County Sheriff's Office is reviewing new tips and video alongside the district's review.

stories.title: Saudi Arabia planning offensive against Houthis to break Red Sea chokehold
stories.summary: Saudi Arabia is preparing a military offensive, potentially mobilizing more than 100,000 Yemeni troops, to dislodge Houthi militants who seized control of the Bab el-Mandeb strait last month. Riyadh sees the Houthis' capture of the key shipping route as giving them global leverage, and won't restart peace talks while they hold it.

stories.title: Pro-government forces say they retake airport in Ethiopia's Tigray region
stories.summary: Ethiopian government-affiliated forces said they have recaptured an airport in the Tigray region, marking a notable territorial advance amid renewed fighting. The claim signals a shift in the conflict as government forces press to regain control of key areas.

stories.title: flydubai co-pilot attacked captain with axe in attempted terrorist attack, UAE says
stories.summary: The UAE said a flydubai co-pilot attacked the captain of a flight to Israel with an axe in what officials describe as an attempted terrorist attack, with no serious injuries reported. The suspect's identity and motive remain under investigation.

stories.title: Iran's IRGC warns of 'more lethal' response as Houthi missile debris injures Saudi resident
stories.summary: Iran's Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps threatened a more lethal response than its October 2024 strike on Israel if attacked, as Saudi Arabia reported intercepting Houthi missiles and falling debris injuring a resident in the Asir region. US warships are moving toward the Middle East as Gulf tensions spike.
